players.product: semiconductor-grade polycrystalline silicon; high-purity isopropyl alcohol (IPA) for electronics manufacturing

quarterly_data.signal: Fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 (annual securities report): net sales JPY 349,476 million (+1.9%), operating profit JPY 37,017 million (+23.5%), ordinary profit JPY 38,203 million (+29.1%), profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 22,205 million (-5.1%). Management attributes the sales and operating-profit growth to firm sales of semiconductor-related products and progress in manufacturing cost improvements; sales also rose on the new consolidation of the Tokuyama Life Science group (in-vitro diagnostics, consolidated from the third quarter). Extraordinary items include a provision for loss on a non-cancellable long-term power purchase agreement with a power producer. Other segments (sales / operating profit): Chemicals JPY 106,226 million (-7.6%) / JPY 9,701 million (-10.4%); Cement JPY 66,881 million (+3.4%) / JPY 9,536 million (+27.9%); Life Science JPY 49,387 million (+17.7%) / JPY 7,828 million (+0.2%); Environment JPY 6,129 million (+17.5%) / JPY 655 million (prior year JPY 52 million). Sales by customer location: Japan JPY 257,591 million, Asia JPY 68,137 million, other regions JPY 23,748 million. No single external customer accounts for 10% or more of net sales.
quarterly_data.figure: Net sales JPY 349,476 million (+1.9%); operating profit JPY 37,017 million (+23.5%)

quarterly_data.signal: Electronic & Advanced Materials segment, year to March 2026 (annual securities report, management's analysis): semiconductor-grade polycrystalline silicon earned more on manufacturing cost improvements and changes in product mix; IC chemicals earned more as sales volumes of high-purity isopropyl alcohol for electronics manufacturing increased; dry silica earned more on firm sales volumes and lower manufacturing costs at the Zhejiang (China) subsidiary; thermal management materials earned more as sales volumes rose, mainly for semiconductor production equipment. Segment sales JPY 91,675 million (+5.3%), operating profit JPY 15,681 million (+63.6%); segment production (at selling prices) JPY 99,011 million (+13.7%). Management states the segment's profit rose sharply versus fiscal 2020, when Medium-Term Management Plan 2025 was drawn up, but results ran below the plan's initial assumptions because growth of the semiconductor market stalled temporarily.
quarterly_data.figure: Electronic & Advanced Materials sales JPY 91,675 million (+5.3%); operating profit JPY 15,681 million (+63.6%)

quarterly_data.signal: Medium-Term Management Plan 2025, final year (fiscal 2025, year to March 2026) results vs targets (annual securities report): net sales JPY 349.4 billion vs a plan of JPY 400.0 billion; operating profit JPY 37.0 billion vs JPY 45.0 billion; growth-business sales CAGR 9.6% vs 10% or more; ROE 8.2% vs 11% or more. The company states the semiconductor market is expanding, centered on advanced fields, but is behind the plan, and domestic demand for chemicals and cement shrank; across the group sales were 12.6% and operating profit 17.7% below plan. A new Medium-Term Management Plan 2030 was announced on May 29, 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: MTP2025 final year: sales JPY 349.4 billion vs plan JPY 400.0 billion; OP JPY 37.0 billion vs JPY 45.0 billion

quarterly_data.signal: Portfolio moves (annual securities report): growth businesses are positioned as Electronics, Healthcare and Environment. In Electronics the company established OCI Tokuyama Semiconductor Materials Sdn. Bhd. in Malaysia (Sarawak; 50% owned, equity-method affiliate) with Korea's OCI group to make and sell semi-finished products for semiconductor polycrystalline silicon; working with the production and sales site under construction in Vietnam (TOKUYAMA VIETNAM CO., LTD.), it is building a production and supply system for semiconductor polycrystalline silicon. The company exited its microporous film business in China (completed February 2026), will transfer its domestic cement and solidifier sales business (with two subsidiaries) into a new subsidiary to be sold to Taiheiyo Cement on October 1, 2026 (planned; share transfer agreement signed March 25, 2026), and has begun considering stopping cement and solidifier production around fiscal 2028. It also set up Tokuyama India Private Limited for marketing and sales in Electronics, Healthcare and Environment.

Capital expenditure, year to March 2026 (annual securities report): JPY 32,759 million, of which Electronic & Advanced Materials JPY 13,202 million for construction of a semiconductor polycrystalline silicon processing plant in Vietnam, construction of an electronics-grade high-purity isopropyl alcohol recycling facility in Taiwan, expansion of aluminum nitride filler manufacturing equipment and other capacity additions and upgrades; Chemicals JPY 2,569 million, Cement JPY 3,087 million, Life Science JPY 1,728 million, Environment JPY 542 million, other and corporate JPY 11,628 million (including equipment for biomass co-firing at the power plant). Plan for the following year (new builds and expansions): JPY 46,119 million - Electronic & Advanced Materials JPY 18,599 million, Chemicals JPY 7,566 million, Cement JPY 4,531 million, Life Science JPY 4,014 million, Environment JPY 301 million, other JPY 4,123 million, corporate JPY 6,982 million; the company notes the amounts may change, by segment or in total, depending on the Middle East situation (uncertain raw-material and fuel procurement and rising costs remain downside risks). Main electronics facilities at March 31, 2026 include TOKUYAMA VIETNAM CO., LTD. (Ba Ria-Vung Tau, silicon manufacturing equipment, book value JPY 4,371 million), the Kaohsiung (Taiwan) high-purity IPA plant (JPY 11,052 million) and STAC Co., Ltd. (Ulsan, South Korea, high-purity IPA, JPY 15,575 million).
quarterly_data.figure: Capex JPY 32,759 million (E&AM JPY 13,202 million); plan JPY 46,119 million (E&AM JPY 18,599 million)

quarterly_data.signal: R&D (annual securities report): group R&D expense JPY 17,706 million, of which Electronic & Advanced Materials JPY 2,399 million. The Tsukuba and Tokuyama research laboratories work on peripheral materials for advanced semiconductors, organic-inorganic composites, nanoparticle materials, medical materials and anion-exchange membrane materials for water electrolysis. Electronic & Advanced Materials: silica - property improvements and new applications for existing products, surface-treatment technology for semiconductor miniaturization and new oxide powders based on silica production technology, plus sample work for new needs such as photonic-electronic convergence; thermal management materials - new grades and property improvements of aluminum nitride and boron nitride fillers for heat-dissipating resin parts of advanced packages for AI semiconductors and power semiconductors, under customer evaluation; the filler particle-size and surface-treatment lineup was expanded and aluminum nitride filler capacity was increased. New Business division: the SiN group made customer samples on mass-production trial equipment built at the Advanced Technology Commercialization Center and is improving mass-production technology with future power-device quality requirements in mind; the electrolysis group began building large brine electrolyzers and is developing and demonstrating high-pressure alkaline water electrolysis (AWE).
quarterly_data.figure: R&D JPY 17,706 million (Electronic & Advanced Materials JPY 2,399 million)
